verses.2: Until these words are spoken, and the great spirit says your words.
verses.3: May the Lord judge fairly, and may the judges judge justly.
verses.4: If your children sin, let them be punished by their own sins.
verses.5: If you pray to God and to the saints, then you will be saved.
verses.6: If you are righteous and just, then now let it be fulfilled that your righteousness may be completed.
verses.7: And your beginning will be difficult, but your end will bring great joy.
verses.8: Please ask Dr. Rishon and others to study their ancestors’ traditions.
verses.9: For we will die, and we will not know whether our days on this earth will be long or short.
verses.10: They will not speak to you, nor will their lips utter any words.
verses.11: He will rejoice without having any sorrow; he will be happy without any tears.
verses.12: He will not be caught in any trap, and before all the wild animals, he will be safe.
verses.13: So, all those who forget God will be punished, and their wickedness will be destroyed.
verses.14: Those who have built a temple and a house of worship from nothing.
verses.15: He will be saved in his house, but he will not stand firm or hold onto it. He will also not get up from there.
verses.16: He is weak before the sun, and on his garden, bees nectarate it.
verses.17: On top of its roots, a house of stones will be built.
verses.18: If he swallows us from our place, and ignores us completely.
verses.19: He also makes his way through the paths, and from one place to another.
verses.20: He shall not be deceived, nor take hold of the hands of the wicked.
verses.21: Until the day comes when your lips and your teeth will be broken.
verses.22: Your detestables will be covered with dirt, and the houses of the wicked will not be saved.
